action: Meet with Rick Tanner about Hawkins dealership disposition, follow up with Amir Patel on $350 valuation fee and listing intent, call Betty Kowalski on RoboRide status, publish LinkedIn market signal post
narrative: Stephanie got the meeting with Rick Tanner — a 25-minute call Wednesday that went better than expected. Rick confirmed the Hawkins disposition process is moving to formal RFP stage within 30 days and asked Stephanie to send her buyer profile analysis in writing before the end of the week; he said he would put her name to the disposition committee as the agent who had already done the market work. Not a signed listing agreement, but a formal position inside the process — which is the most any agent could achieve at this stage. Amir Patel confirmed the $350 valuation fee by phone Thursday and said he was leaning toward the adaptive reuse sale path; he asked whether Stephanie would be available to bring the listing to market by the end of next month. Betty Kowalski reported the written RoboRide terms never arrived — she is now actively thinking about the diner's future and agreed to meet Stephanie for coffee next week. The LinkedIn post generated three direct messages from auto row property owners Stephanie had never spoken to. Net savings delta includes base monthly surplus of $1,314 plus the $350 Amir fee collected, totaling $1,664.
